meta.title: Iceland energy parties — reference seed
meta.description: Machine-readable companion to docs/reference/iceland-energy-parties.md. Designed as the seed payload for a future energy.parties + energy.tariff_catalogue model. Snake_case throughout to match the Prisma schema conventions in CLAUDE.md.

conventions.kennitala_format: DDMMYY-XXXX. Iceland's national ID convention. First two digits 41–69 indicate a legal entity (day = real_day + 40).
conventions.vsk_format: Numeric VAT registration with Skatturinn. Pulled from invoices when known; null otherwise. Do not invent VSK numbers from search-engine snippets.
conventions.money_format: Prices preserve the source's exact rendering as strings. Numeric strings ('8.64', '11,52') are parseable to decimal; conversion to BIGINT minor units (aurar) happens at migration time, not here. Sentinels: null = not specified, '~XX' or '≈XX' = approximate, 'see_app' / 'free' / 'rebate' / 'higher' / 'varies' = descriptive non-numeric values that need manual interpretation before billing math.
conventions.vat_pct: Number when known (24, 11), null when not applicable (Landsnet wholesale, USD-denominated stórnotandi, descriptive rebate rows).
conventions.consolidation: Where one legal entity (same kennitala) publishes multiple tariff schedules under different slugs — Orkubú Vestfjarða has separate sales and distribution PDFs, kept as ov-sales and ov-dso — both records carry the same kennitala. The future migration script may collapse them into a single party with N tariff_schedules.

role_legend.producer: Owns generation assets — hydro, geothermal, wind.
role_legend.public_charging: Operates one or more public EV charging networks (CPO).
role_legend.home_charging: Sells or subscribes home / MDU / workplace charger hardware and installation services. Not the same as public_charging.
role_legend.aggregator: Group-buying or comparison platform; resells someone else's electricity.

ev_category_legend.public_ev: Public/destination/curbside charging (almenningshleðsla). DC fast or public AC. Customer-facing.
ev_category_legend.workplace_ev: Workplace / MDU / fleet AC charging (fyrirtækjahleðsla, employer subsidy products).
ev_category_legend.home_ev: Home charging products (heimahleðsla, night rates marketed for EV owners).
ev_category_legend.general_supply: Generic household or business electricity supply — the baseline a home/workplace EV plugs into.
ev_category_legend.not_ev: Distribution-side, heating, street lighting, industrial afltaxti, connection fees, admin fees, transmission-only items. Kept for completeness; hidden by default in EV-context UIs.

meta.maintenance_policy: Re-verify tariff_source.url quarterly. Re-fetch tariff_items when tariff_source.valid_from is more than 18 months old. Treat the markdown reference doc as the human-edited source of truth; regenerate this JSON from it when prices change.

parties.notes: Same legal entity as the Westfjords DSO (slug 'ov-dso'). Operates 16 public chargers on the e1 platform — open to any EV via the e1 app.
Exited retail. Customers redirected to Orkusalan. Subsidiary of Norðurorka. Kept for historical session reconciliation only.

Largest CPO in Iceland. Olís, ÓB, hotels and many municipal sites are hosted on the Ísorka network. Per-station pricing surfaces through the Hleðsluappið mobile app rather than as a single published schedule. Bands are typical 2026 street rates.

tariff_items.applies_to: Volvo / Polestar / Ford / Mazda / Citroën / Peugeot / Opel

parties.notes: Brimborg-affiliated CPO. 17 DC fast-charging stations (DC30 → DC600). Pricing tiered by station capacity, surfaced through the eONE / e1 app. Operates Iceland's first 600 kW station in Reykjanesbær.

Fuel-station chain. Public chargers at Olís and ÓB locations are operated on the Ísorka network and accessed via the Ísorka app — Olís is the host, Ísorka is the technical CPO. Pricing is from the 2021 launch announcement and is likely outdated; treat the Ísorka app as the source of truth.

Fuel-station chain (parent: Festi hf., kt 540206-2010). Distinct from N1 Rafmagn ehf (slug 'n1-rafmagn'), the electricity retail subsidiary. Public DC fast chargers live at major N1 fuel sites around the ring road; access and payment via the N1 app (card or N1 points). Per-kWh rates surface in the verðskrá page / app; bands are typical 2026 fast-charge street rates pending re-scrape.
